Orbit Breach

Play Orbit Breach, a polygon survival game. Steer around the core, dodge incoming walls, choose five-, six-, or eight-sided arenas, and beat your local best time.

Find the gap.

Hold left or right to steer around the core. Keep your pilot out of the approaching walls.

Controls and rules

Hold Left/Right or A/D to move around the core. On a phone, hold either steering button or the left/right half of the arena. Space or Enter starts a run; Space pauses a running game. P pauses or resumes. R starts a new run. The game pauses automatically when the tab is hidden or the window loses focus, and never resumes by itself.

Stay inside each ring’s opening as the walls pass your orbit. Speed increases gradually, with a stage every 15 seconds. Gentle and Normal have two open polygon sectors; Expert has one. Consecutive gaps move by at most two sectors. Choose a different arena or difficulty after a run ends. Best times are stored only in this browser, separately for each mode; play still works if storage is unavailable.

Motion toggles the slow rotation of the whole arena. Reduced motion starts with that rotation off; wall movement is part of the game and starts only when you press Start. There are no flashes or screen shakes. Pause freezes the entire run; Save frame exports the arena as a PNG.

The pilot uses a small circular hitbox inside its triangular marker. The same polygon wall coordinates are used for drawing and collision tests. Simulation runs in bounded 240 Hz steps, independent of the display refresh rate.

An original Fractal Space game inspired by the polygon-survival idea of Super Hexagon by Terry Cavanagh ↗. Code and graphics are original; see license and credits.
